newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index edges lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index edges lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed down by 0.32 percent, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 500.54 from 502.17 on Wednesday.
Volume was 1.38 million dinars against 273,389 dinars. Turnover on the first market was 359,636 dinars while it was 907,792 on the occasional and over-the-counter market.
Retail stores Monoprix was down 1.88 dinars to 30.12 dinars. BNA bank eased 1.01 dinars to 32.79.
Banque du Sud was up 0.77 dinar to 26.54. Insurance company Astree rose 0.5 dinar to 34.5.
